---
title: "Question corpus"
subtitle: "Thirty unchanged STACK exports, with a measured adapter boundary"
---

These are 30 native STACK XML questions from the upstream library. Each question below has a local XML download, its pinned upstream source, and a result from the current adapter. **Only the 18 questions whose authored tests passed on every replayed seed have interactive cards.** The others remain available for inspection, with the observed mismatch or unsupported feature shown explicitly.

The [reproducible baseline](questions/corpus/baseline.json) reports **18 passed**, **1 with test mismatches**, and **11 blocked** (4 at import, 7 at instantiation). It retained **73 authored test cases** and replayed **132 seed/case combinations** across 19 instantiated questions; 2 combinations disagreed. Passing those bounded checks is evidence for the listed seeds, not complete STACK/Maxima parity.

**Attribution and reuse.** Questions are from [STACK / maths/moodle-qtype_stack](https://github.com/maths/moodle-qtype_stack), pinned at commit [`10d323311b7f39fb7b092dd10ce75f7d8632f525`](https://github.com/maths/moodle-qtype_stack/commit/10d323311b7f39fb7b092dd10ce75f7d8632f525). The unchanged question exports carry the [CC BY-SA 4.0 license](https://github.com/maths/moodle-qtype_stack/blob/10d323311b7f39fb7b092dd10ce75f7d8632f525/samplequestions/COPYING.txt), also [included locally](questions/corpus/COPYING.txt); see each pinned source link below. The [manifest](questions/corpus/manifest.json) records the exact upstream path and SHA-256 for every XML file.

Their source panels expose the actual XML used by each card, and every original remains separately downloadable.

## Authored test mismatches

These cases disagree with expectations authored in the XML and are kept out of the interactive gallery. Reviewed causes are named below; an authored-test mismatch alone does not identify whether the cause is the port or the original question. The [baseline JSON](questions/corpus/baseline.json) retains the exact expected and observed results.

### AlgMap-8.10 {#algmap-8-10}

**Upstream authoring bug in the PRT.** At the failing variant, `a=8`, `b=9`, `c=2`, and `d=3`, so the correct answer is `8*(t+y)/2 + 9*(t+y)/3 = 7*(t+y)`. Both authored model answers therefore have no fraction operator. The only full-credit branch requires `SingleFrac`, which rejects this product; every later branch awards zero. Authored tests 1 and 2 nevertheless expect full credit. The pinned native STACK test also rejects `7*(t+y)` under `SingleFrac`. The port's random choices expose a latent assumption in the original question; this diagnosis uses the fixed values above, rather than assuming Maxima generates those values for the same seed.

Algebra Refresher / 08 Algebraic fractions · **2 failed of 12 replayed seed/case combinations.** For seed `1856951054`, case `1`, input `ans = (7*(t + y))`: `prt1` expected score `1.0` and answer note `1-0-T`, but produced score `0.0` and answer note `1-0-F | 1-1-F`.

[Download original XML](questions/corpus/AlgMap-8-10.xml) · [Pinned upstream source](https://github.com/maths/moodle-qtype_stack/blob/10d323311b7f39fb7b092dd10ce75f7d8632f525/samplequestions/stacklibrary/Algebra-Refresher/08-Algebraic-fractions/AlgMap-8-10.xml) · [Full replay](questions/corpus/baseline.json)
